correctness.rationale: The similarity chart is locally complete and uniquely gauges all four deformation variables. Akiyama–Kamae’s exact paired-edge angular integration gives a moment formula; near a square opposite-edge terms are O(q³), and an explicit signed positive adjacent-determinant expansion gives P and E W² through degree 2. Symbolic exact Hessian is diag(π(π−2)/32, π/8, π(2−π)/8, π(2−π)/8); signs follow since π>2. The independent checker extracted from the actual package runs exact derivatives and 56 direct angular quadratures; it is support, not an infinite proof. The claimed cone is stated only to leading quadratic order.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A stronger statement about full four-gon extrema or Hessians would subsume this local Morse classification, but none was located among inspected primary claims. The broad moment identity is used to derive rather than imply the exact new derivative computation.

value.rationale: The four-gon global width-deviation problem is explicitly motivated and unresolved in the 2022 primary source. The full local Morse-index computation identifies a canonical square saddle with two symmetry-preserving stable and two symmetry-breaking unstable dimensions and an exact sharp quadratic boundary, a structural classification of the whole local shape space. This is more than a trivial renaming, finite experiment or a single negative perturbation, but deliberately does not purport to settle the global minimizer.
